{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing values in key columns for analysis
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['species', 'flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = df_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print the full mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species"}
